Food Safety Officials Inspect Blinkit Unit After Worms Found in Eggs

Karnataka food safety officials inspected a Blinkit stock and supply unit in Mangaluru after a consumer complaint about worms found in eggs. The inspection followed a complaint made to Health Minister U.T. Khader. The Food Safety and Drug Administration Department conducted the inspection at the quick-commerce facility.
